title: Business Analyst
description:
**About the Company** 




 Scapia is a co\-branded credit card built to make travel happen for people, by converting their everyday expenses into travel experiences. We’re a bunch of passionate people who work together, brainstorm, and debate with each other, and don’t stop until we’re proud of our work. Customer delight tops everything else — we’ve worked hard to create an environment of honesty and passion that sets everyone up for success.
 



**Role :** 




 Business Analyst, Commerce and Customer Support \& Experience \- owning analytics for Scapia's Commerce charter as well as org\-level Customer Support \& Experience use cases. You will work closely with Commerce/Store product and category teams, and with the Scapia customer support team, to turn data into decisions across both charters.
 



**Scope of Role :** 




 You will own the data models and analysis that power decision\-making across Scapia's Commerce vertical, focused on three charter areas:
 



 • Commerce category growth analytics \- track and diagnose GMV/order growth by category, and
 



 identify the levers (new users, repeat purchase, basket size, category mix) driving or dragging
 



 growth.
 



 • Product performance analysis \- build recurring views of how products/listings perform (conversion, returns, margin, ratings) to inform catalog, pricing, and vendor decisions.
 



 • Commerce inventory forecasting \- build demand and stock\-cover models that help the
 



 category/procurement teams avoid stockouts and overstock.
 



 In addition, you will own analytics for Scapia's org\-level Customer Support \& Experience use cases (not limited to Commerce):
 



 • Customer support \& experience analytics — build models and dashboards that help the CX support team prioritize tickets, predict escalations, track sentiment, and plan resourcing.
 



  





*Beyond these charter areas, you will:* 




 • Work closely with business and product teams to understand challenges, break problems into
 



 analytical components, and deliver insights that influence strategy.
 



 • Independently plan, execute, and deliver analytical projects with high quality, finding solutions to mitigate risks and dependencies along the way.
 



 • Use AI\-powered tools (Claude Code, Copilot, etc.) throughout your workflow (for SQL, Python, and reporting) to be more productive.
 



  





*Example Projects You’ll Drive* 




 Commerce Category Growth Analytics
 



 • Category growth diagnostics: decompose GMV/order growth for each commerce category into
 



 new\-user acquisition, repeat purchase, basket size, and category mix shifts — and flag which
 



 categories are decelerating and why.
 



 • Category expansion / cross\-sell: identify which category a customer is most likely to try next, based on current purchase pattern and Scapia Coins engagement, to prioritize placement, offers, and homepage real estate.
 



 Product Performance Analysis
 



 • Product performance scorecards: build a repeatable view of top\- and bottom\-performing
 



 SKUs/listings by conversion, return rate, and margin to inform catalog curation and vendor
 



 conversations.
 



 • New product / category launch tracking: define success metrics and track performance of newly onboarded products or categories over their first 30/60/90 days, flagging underperformers early.
 



 Commerce Inventory Forecasting
 



 • Demand forecasting: build category/SKU\-level demand forecasts using historical sales, seasonality, and the promotional calendar to reduce stockouts and overstock.
 



 • Inventory health monitoring: build a live view of stock cover, aging inventory, and reorder triggers to support procurement and vendor discussions.
 



 Scapia Customer Support \& Experience
 



 • Support ticket prioritization model: score and rank incoming tickets by urgency/impact so agents work the highest\-priority issues first.
 



 • Ticket escalation predictive scoring: predict which open tickets are likely to escalate, using early signals from ticket content, customer history, and agent handling, so they can be pre\-empted.
 



 • NPS sentiment analytics and recommendations: analyze NPS verbatims and support interactions to surface sentiment drivers and recommend actions to the CX org.
 



 • Ticket/contact volume projections: forecast ticket and contact volumes by channel/category to
 



 support CX Agent staffing and resource planning.
 



  





**What We're Looking For :** 




 Education \& Professional Background
 



 • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a
 



 related quantitative field.
 



 • 1–3 years of experience in a Business Analyst, Data Analyst, Data Scientist, or Analytics role at a product\-based B2C organization; exposure to e\-commerce/commerce analytics is a strong plus.
 



 Core Skills
 



 • Strong proficiency in SQL and Excel — able to write queries to extract, filter, and analyze data from structured and unstructured tables.
 



 • Working knowledge of Python for data mining, analysis, statistical modeling, and machine learning.
 



 • Working knowledge of AI\-powered agents (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, etc.) to accelerate SQL, Python, and analytical workflows.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with a BI tool (Tableau, Power BI, QuickSight, Looker, or similar).
 



 • Solid understanding of statistical concepts (correlation, regression, segmentation, hypothesis testing, and statistical significance)
 



 • Ability to break down complex business problems into analytical components and work
 



 collaboratively to solve them.
 



 • Prior exposure to A/B testing or experimentation frameworks is a plus
 



 • Familiarity with data tools (Databricks, Airflow) or cloud environments (AWS/GCP) is a plus
 



 Communication Skills
 



 • Exceptional written and verbal communication \- able to explain complex findings clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
 



 • Ability to multitask and manage diverse analytical requirements simultaneously.
 



 • Collaborative mindset with strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.

**EY GDS \- Delivery Excellence Senior position**
 Within last decade, cost of delivery and Delivery excellence has become the most critical factors to run successful and popular businesses spread around the globe. To support such a dynamic and fast paced IT transformation industry, we are using various cutting\-edge Delivery Excellence models and tools with relentless focus on automation to offer best in class and tailor\-made solutions to our clients.
   

  

 As a part of our global team you will be part of GDS projects as Delivery Excellence management professional. You will be involved in working on challenging problems and creating next generation delivery excellence platforms.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Are you a detail driven professional with a passion for translating business needs into impactful product experiences? Do you thrive at the intersection of people, process, and technology? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join our Product team and help shape solutions that deliver real value to our clients and users.
   

  

 In this role, you’ll serve as a critical bridge between the business stakeholders and the development and engineering teams. Your work will influence how ideas become features, how features become products, and how products deliver meaningful outcomes in a fast paced, evolving environment.
   

  

 As a key member of the Product team, you will play a hands on role in defining business requirements, crafting user stories, and ensuring that technical execution aligns seamlessly with business objectives. You will lead user acceptance testing (UAT), drive iterative testing cycles, validate enhancements, and ensure that issues or defects are accurately identified, tracked, and resolved. Your keen eye for detail and strong communication skills will help ensure that every release meets the highest standards of quality and functionality.
   

  

 This is a client facing and user centric role where you will engage with stakeholders, address queries, clarify requirements, and ensure that feedback is incorporated into continuous product improvements. You’ll gain a deep understanding of real world user behaviors, business processes, and product journeys—making this the perfect place to grow as a product focused business professional while driving meaningful impact across the product lifecycle.
   

  

 If you’re energized by the opportunity to influence product development end to end, collaborate with cross functional teams, and help bring scalable, user friendly solutions to life, this role provides the platform for you to make a lasting difference.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements, ensuring alignment across stakeholders, product managers, and engineering teams.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by testing the defined test cases, validating functionality, and ensuring readiness for release.
* Support in iterative testing cycles, identifying defects, documenting issues, validating fixes, and performing regression testing as needed.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
* Serve as one of the primary liaison between business teams and engineering, providing clarifications, resolving requirement gaps, and ensuring shared understanding throughout the product lifecycle.
* Review and validate bug fixes, ensuring that resolved issues meet expected outcomes before closure.
* Engage with clients and end users, addressing queries, troubleshooting issues, and gathering feedback for continuous improvement.
* Support product rollout activities, including release planning, communication, and training support where required.
* Monitor product performance post release, identify enhancement opportunities, and contribute to backlog prioritization.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation including requirement specifications, UAT plans, test results, and user feedback logs.
* Support product strategy, roadmap planning, and end\-to\-end product lifecycle management for Internal Controls and Audit solutions.
* Partner with stakeholders across business, risk, audit, and technology teams to gather requirements and drive product adoption.
* Own MIS, reporting, KPI tracking, and executive dashboards to measure product performance and business outcomes.
* Analyse large datasets to derive insights, identify control gaps, and support decision\-making.
* Drive product implementation, rollout, user onboarding, and change management initiatives.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to define functional requirements and prioritise product backlogs.
* Identify automation and AI opportunities to enhance audit and internal control processes.

* Control Automation – Identify automation opportunities using analytics platform to monitor the operational effectiveness on the regular basis.
* Basic exposure to Presales, solutioning, proposal support, or client presentations is a plus.
* Interest in working in tech\-enabled or AI\-led Risk products/solutions environment.
* Ability to support senior team members in product development, go\-to\-market efforts, and client engagements.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with business delivery teams.
* Analytical thinking.
* Strong team\-player and self\-started attitude.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, global delivery environment with distributed teams.
* Well organized, attentive to details attitude.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

**What Working At EY Offers**

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. * Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around

title: Business Analyst ( Entry level)
description:
**ABOUT OSETTL TECHNOLOGIES** 




 Osettl Technologies builds Legodesk — legal\-powered recovery infrastructure for Indian lenders. Banks, NBFCs, fintechs and ARCs use our platform to run debt resolution and NPA recovery across Section 138 NI Act, SARFAESI, DRT/DRAT and IBC/NCLT workflows.
 



 We are a profitable, seed\-stage company, ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certified, CERT\-In empanelled, and incubated at IIM Bangalore’s NSRCEL Velocity – Kotak BizLabs programme.
 



  





**ROLE SUMMARY** 




 You sit between our lender clients, the operations team and product \& engineering. You turn client requirements into clear specifications, working software and signed\-off releases.
 




 This is a requirements and delivery role, not a reporting or dashboarding role. Roughly 70% of the work is specification, stakeholder alignment and UAT; the remaining 30% is analysis to support those decisions. Candidates looking for a pure analytics or MIS position should not apply.
 




  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**•** 
  Elicit and document requirements from lender clients and internal operations; convert them into BRDs, functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria.
 



 •   Map current and target\-state process flows for recovery workflows; identify gaps, exceptions and control points before a line of code is written.
 



 •   Own the product backlog with engineering — prioritisation, grooming, sprint planning and clarification of scope during the build.
 



 •   Plan and run UAT — test scenarios, defect triage, client sign\-off and release notes.
 



 •   Specify lender integrations with engineering — data models, API and file\-based contracts, field mapping and reconciliation rules.
 



 •   Act as the day\-to\-day point of contact for client stakeholders through discovery, build and go\-live; run requirement walkthroughs and review meetings.
 



 •   Support configuration and rollout of new client onboardings, including data migration checks and user training material.
 



 •   Analyse recovery funnel performance to validate requirements and size new opportunities — resolution rates, notice\-to\-payment conversion, turnaround time by stage, cost per recovery — and maintain the review reporting that goes with it.
 



  





**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** 




**•** 
 2–5 years as a Business Analyst or Product Analyst — fintech, lending, collections, BFSI or B2B SaaS preferred.
 



 •   Demonstrated ownership of requirements documentation — BRDs / FRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria and process flows — for features that shipped to production.
 



 •   Experience delivering under a defined SDLC — Agile sprints, Waterfall or hybrid — including backlog grooming, sprint ceremonies, UAT planning and release sign\-off.
 



 •   Ability to map and document structured, multi\-stage legal workflows — the Section 138 NI Act lifecycle, SARFAESI notice stages under Sections 13(2\) and 13(4\), DRT and NCLT filings, and notice\-to\-execution tracking. Prior hands\-on exposure is preferred; demonstrated ability to learn a regulated workflow to specification level is mandatory.
 



 •   Working understanding of confidentiality controls in a regulated environment — role\-based access control, audit trails, maker\-checker approvals and data privacy obligations — and the ability to specify them as product requirements rather than treat them as an afterthought.
 



 •   Confidence running requirement workshops and review meetings directly with client stakeholders, including senior operations and credit leadership at lenders.
 



 •   Working knowledge of SQL and advanced Excel / Google Sheets, sufficient to interrogate data and validate a specification.
 



 •   Strong written and spoken English; clear, structured documentation is a core output of this role.
 



 •   Bachelor’s degree in engineering, commerce, economics, statistics or a related discipline.
 



  





**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** 




 •   Hands\-on experience with debt collections, NPA recovery, matter management, contract lifecycle management or legal billing systems.
 



 •   Understanding of RBI recovery agent guidelines, the Fair Practices Code, or DPDP Act 2023 obligations.
 



 •   Familiarity with API documentation, wireframing tools and a BI or reporting tool.
 



 •   Prior experience in an early\-stage company with ambiguous, fast\-changing requirements.

**Job Title: Senior Analyst \- Social listening \& Consumer Insights
   

  

 Location: Bangalore
   

  

 Reporting to: Manager \- Digital Marketing**
* PURPOSE OF ROLE:


 We are seeking a skilled and analytical Social Listening Analyst to design, execute, and deliver custom social listening reports that inform strategic decision\-making across the organization. The role involves engaging with stakeholders to gather business requirements and translating them into structured, platform\-specific queries that monitor social conversations around internal brands, competitors, products, marketing campaigns, and key events.
   

  

 The Analyst will be responsible for conducting in\-depth analysis of unstructured social media data, identifying key themes and sentiment drivers, and synthesizing findings into concise, insight\-driven narratives. The ability to differentiate meaningful signals from noise and communicate insights in a business\-relevant context is critical.
   

  

 This role requires a high degree of independence, as assignments may lack predefined templates or processes. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong problem\-solving capabilities, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to manage cross\-functional collaboration effectively. Additionally, the role includes working with multilingual content, requiring the Analyst to derive culturally contextualized insights from non\-English sources.
   

  

* KEY TASKS AND ACCOUNTABILITIES
* Consult with stakeholders to define social listening topics, metrics, and filtering criteria aligned to business objectives across standard, ad\-hoc, and industry reports.
* Design and implement social listening setups, including query parameters, keyword configurations, and dashboard creation across approved tools.
* Pull, interpret, and analyze data from social listening platforms to assess volume, sentiment, conversation drivers, influencer activity, and emerging trends.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams \- including Marketing Insights, Marketing, and Brand teams \- to integrate social media insights into broader research initiatives and campaigns.
* Champion a holistic, consumer\-centric view \- connecting the dots between what consumers say, how they engage, and what influences their perceptions and behaviors.
* Present insights and recommendations in a clear, structured manner to inform strategic and tactical decision\-making.
* Create and edit reporting deliverables in PowerPoint, Excel, and newsletter formats that effectively transform social data into actionable narratives.
* Visualize findings through charts, tables, and infographics to clearly communicate insights to diverse stakeholder groups.
* Maintain a recurring and ad\-hoc reporting calendar, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of outputs.
* Demonstrate high attention to detail and data accuracy in all reports, with strong written communication and data storytelling skills.
* Proactively refine and optimize social listening queries to ensure data relevance, minimize noise, and enhance the quality of insights.
* Monitor and share industry best practices and case studies to support capability building within the insights function.
* Adhere to global social listening collaboration protocols, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards and processes.
* Apply a blend of technical proficiency, business acumen, and interpersonal skills to interpret data and influence key stakeholders.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining high quality and consistency across deliverables.
* Contribute to identifying earned consumer engagement patterns, as well as analyzing campaign\-related performance across platforms.
* QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE \& SKILLS
* 2 \- 4 years of experience in social listening, consumer insights or social media marketing roles.
* Proven experience with social listening and analytics platforms such as Brandwatch, Sprinklr, Cision, Emplifi, or equivalent tools.
* Experience in Consumer Insights tools such as GWI, CreatorIQ, MeltWater or equivalent tools.
* Strong understanding of social media platforms and ecosystems, including Facebook, Instagram, X (formerly Twitter), YouTube, blogs, forums, and emerging channels.
* Demonstrated analytical skills with experience in data gathering, interpretation, and the development of actionable, insight\-driven recommendations.
* Experience building Boolean queries and refining search logic for accuracy and relevance.
* Basic understanding of sentiment analysis and natural language processing.
* Ability to identify emerging trends within the beverage industry and broader social media landscape; culturally aware and informed on global digital conversations.
* Skilled at distilling complex datasets into clear, concise, and business\-relevant insights.
* Strong multitasking and time management abilities with a consistent track record of delivering high\-quality outputs under tight deadlines.
* Naturally curious and detail\-oriented, with a deep interest in uncovering the “why” behind social trends and behavioral shifts.
* Self\-starter with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and a proactive approach to problem\-solving.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to confidently present findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a cross\-functional, fast\-paced environment.


**Mandatory Skills:** 
 Digital Marketing, Social Listening, Expertise in PPT and Advanced Excel
   

  

**Preferred Skills:** 
 Power BI, Stakeholder Management
   

  

*And above all of this, an undying love for beer!
   

  

 We dream big to create future with more cheers.*

 Credible experience working in a fast\-moving, client\-driven environment
   

  

**Technologies and Tools**
 Refer the ‘Essentials’ section above

 A team which has its foundation in the core values of trust, respect and teaming. The team which focuses on supporting its colleagues to excel in their respective domains and provides avenues to help acquire and demonstrate new skills.
   

  

 Opportunities to work with Global Executive risk management teams on strengthening and monitoring compliance framework

title: Data Analyst
description:
**Overview**
**About the Role \& Team**
 Currently we are looking for a
 **Research Analyst** 
 to join our
 **Software research team.** 
 If you are passionate about technology, eager to explore market trends, and ready to develop your analytical and technical skills, we offer the perfect platform for your professional growth. Our team is committed to nurturing talent, providing extensive training, and supporting long\-term career development. You'll work closely with research analysts and the broader forecasting team, owning the analysis and reporting that underpins IDC's published research. This is a strong opportunity for someone who enjoys working with data end\-to\-end — from cleaning and validating it, to modelling trends, to presenting findings in a way that drives decisions.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Conduct Secondary Market Research globally and Primary Market Research internally
* Collect, clean, and validate data from multiple sources, ensuring accuracy and consistency across datasets.
* Perform quantitative analysis on market size, growth rates, and vendor performance using appropriate analytical tools and techniques.
* Create models that reconcile data from disparate sources, including SEC filings, vendor surveys, press releases, primary research, and analyst estimates.
* Identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and key business drivers within large and varied data sets. Design fact and dimension tables for vendor revenue, market sizing, and forecast data
* Model relationships between vendors, products, M\&A activity, and parent/subsidiary corporate structures
* Translate raw data into actionable insight, presenting analysis in a way that's easy for stakeholders to act on.
* Partner with research and forecasting teams to ensure data consistency across publications and deliverables.
* Support ad\-hoc data requests and analysis, adapting quickly to shifting priorities.


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or Engineering (preferred) with a strong understanding of economic principles and their application to market analysis.
* 2\-3 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or market research, ideally within the technology industry.
* Proven experience in financial analysis and market modelling.
* Strong analytical, critical thinking and pattern recognition skills with an understanding of the broader business implications of data findings.
* Skilled in analysing complex datasets and developing predictive models, with familiarity in statistical tools and methodologies.
* Strong English written and verbal communication skills to effectively present research findings.
* Efficient in managing multiple research projects and meeting deadlines. Excellent in problem\-solving around data integrity, redundancy, and scalability.
* Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, formulas – ex. VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data validation, COUNT and macros knowledge is a plus. Experience using Advanced Excel is a must.
* Leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) such as Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and similar AI tools to accelerate research, data extraction, content summarization, information synthesis, and productivity. workflows using strong prompt engineering, rigorous data validation to ensure accuracy and reliability.
* Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.
* Stakeholder communication and presentation skills. Adaptability to shifting priorities and ad\-hoc requests.
* Ability to work effectively in a hybrid work environment.


**Why This Role Stands Out**
 At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high\-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. As the premier global provider of trusted technology intelligence, IDC equips business and technology leaders with the evidence they need to make confident decisions. Our insights inform strategy, investment, and innovation across industries and regions.
   

  

 Recognized by IIAR as Analyst Firm of the Year for five consecutive years, IDC sets the standard for credibility and impact. With more than 1,000 analysts worldwide and a truly global perspective, we combine deep expertise with practical relevance. Here, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your contributions provide the insights leaders rely on every day. It is meaningful work, backed by a culture that supports growth, collaboration, and long\-term career development with a globally respected brand.
   

  

**What We Offer**
* A competitive benefit package with additional companywide (1 day in the summer and global shutdown from 24th Dec to 1st Jan).
* Comprehensive Training: Willingness to learn! We provide extensive training in market research and data analysis.
* Career Growth: Clear pathways for professional development and advancement within the company.
* Work Flexibility: Hybrid work model with a mix of in\-office and work\-from\-home days, along with flexible working hours.
* Supportive Culture: Join a team that values innovation and promotes a supportive and collaborative environment.

This position involves working with large datasets from flight recorders to monitor aircraft health and support return\-to\-service processes. The analyst will collaborate with various teams to interpret data, develop reports, and ensure compliance with industry standards. Additionally, the role includes contributing to the development of new data analysis methodologies and tools, providing technical expertise, and maintaining thorough documentation.

* Construct and manage logical frame definitions for organizing and analyzing large datasets from flight data recorders.

* Develop and maintain documentation and reports related to FDR/CVR readouts, data link readouts, and flight data analysis.

* Strong proficiency in logical frame construction and flight data analysis.
* Mandatory knowledge of ARINC standards, Flight Data Recorders (FDR), Flight Data Acquisition Units (FDAU), and aircraft operational procedures.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical findings clearly and concisely.

You’ll be working closely with business stakeholders to define detailed business questions, problems or opportunities which can be supported through advanced analytics, making sure that new and existing processes are designed to be efficient, simple and automated where possible.

title: Senior Analyst, Pricing Operations
description:
Our Purpose
   

  

 At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.
   

  

**About Us**
 SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI\-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real\-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.
   

  

 Our teams are builders, problem\-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission\-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.
   

  

**What Are We Looking For?**
 We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.
   

  

 As a Senior Analyst, Pricing Programs \& Analytics
 **,** 
 you will sit at the intersection of commercial program execution and applied pricing analytics. You will own the operational mechanics that keep the Flex program running, the feedback loops and documentation that connect field reality to program design, and the deal\-level intelligence — performance reporting, price realization analysis, and trend identification — that translates data into decisions. You will work closely with Advanced Analytics, Deal Desk, Sales Enablement, and GTM Systems to ensure pricing programs are well\-run, well\-documented, and continuously improving.
   

  

**What Will You Do?**
 Primary responsibilities include
 **:**
* Flex Program Operations \& Administration
* Maintain and administer the day\-to\-day mechanics of the Flex program — including rule documentation, eligibility criteria, CPQ floor configurations, and Deal Desk guidance — ensuring program parameters are accurately reflected in systems and field\-facing materials.
* Own the Flex enhancement roadmap tracker: documenting Fast Follow and Future Enhancement items, tracking owner accountability, sequencing dependencies, and flagging items at risk of slipping across quarters.
* Coordinate cross\-functional follow\-through on approved enhancement items — tracking progress with IT, CPQ, Deal Desk, and Enablement without driving senior stakeholder conversations directly.
* Produce and maintain requirements documentation for CPQ and system changes — translating approved program changes into clear, executable specifications and coordinating Deal Desk validation once changes are built.
* Program Analytics \& Commercial Intelligence
* Consume outputs from the Pricing Guidance Engine to produce program\-level adoption and compliance reporting — tracking how Flex deals align to guidance corridors, where discounting concentrates, and how program participation correlates with deal outcomes such as win rates, deal velocity, and expansion rates.
* Build and maintain program\-specific performance views on top of Advanced Analytics' strategic baselines — including Flex attach rates, deal size distributions, remix frequency, and platform expansion patterns.
* Own price waterfall interpretation at the Flex program level — surfacing how Flex deals flow from list to net pocket price, identifying program\-specific margin leakage patterns, and feeding findings back to Advanced Analytics.
* Produce deal behavior analysis that connects Flex and commercial program participation to measurable field outcomes — equipping leadership with a clear picture of what the program is doing to deal quality, not just deal volume.
* Participate in the price realization process — measuring the gap between intended list pricing and what is actually collected after discounts, concessions, and program incentives are applied.
* Analyze transactional data to identify price realization trends and anomalies — by segment, route to market, geography, or deal type — and produce structured findings that distinguish systematic execution gaps from one\-off exceptions.
* Surface price realization insights that connect to program behavior — identifying how Flex participation and commercial program structures are influencing the spread between list and realized price.
* Field Feedback \& Program Intelligence
* Own the seller and partner feedback collection process — designing and distributing surveys, compiling results, and synthesizing field sentiment into organized summaries that leadership can act on.
* Maintain a running tracker of field feedback across Slack threads, Deal Desk escalations, and stakeholder calls — ensuring patterns are captured and recurring friction points are surfaced with supporting evidence.
* Build and maintain QBR materials for the Pricing Programs team, translating performance data and deal behavior analysis into structured, presentation\-ready assets for leadership review.
* Process Documentation \& Enablement Content
* Own the creation and ongoing maintenance of internal Flex process documentation — including step\-by\-step flows for remixes, debook/rebook migrations, and common field scenarios — published via Highspot with version control.
* Maintain the comprehensive internal Flex guide as the single source of truth for AEs, CSMs, Deal Desk, channel sellers, and new hires — keeping it current as program rules evolve.
* Maintain and refresh field\-facing program materials — including the seller cheat sheet, program one\-pagers, FAQs, and eligibility summaries — as pricing rules, thresholds, and features change.
* Support the development of sales motion\-specific enablement assets — including ICP materials, success story compilations, and deal structuring reference guides — working alongside Enablement and Product Marketing.


**What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?**
 Ideal candidates will have:
   

  

* 4\+ years in pricing programs, revenue operations, sales operations, or a commercial analytics role within a SaaS environment.
* Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to build and maintain performance datasets, interpret deal behavior data, and translate outputs into structured, actionable summaries.
* Experience producing and maintaining operational documentation — process flows, program guides, enablement materials — with a track record of keeping content current, version\-controlled, and well\-organized.
* Familiarity with CPQ systems and commercial program mechanics — including eligibility logic, quoting rules, and discount structures — sufficient to write clear system requirements and validate changes.
* Understanding of SaaS commercial models, including subscription, consumption, and hybrid structures, and how commercial vehicles like Flex operate in a field selling context.
* Proficiency with data tools (Excel, SQL, or BI platforms such as Looker or Tableau) to build program scorecards, deal behavior reports, and performance views on top of existing analytical baselines.
* Comfortable working within an established analytical framework — applying and extending existing models and baselines rather than building the intelligence layer independently.
* Excellent cross\-functional communication and coordination skills; able to work effectively with Sales, Deal Desk, Enablement, Advanced Analytics, IT, and Partner teams.
* High attention to detail and strong organizational discipline; able to manage multiple concurrent workstreams without items falling through the cracks.
* Experience in cybersecurity, enterprise software, or platform pricing is a plus.
* Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce or Highspot is a plus.


**Why SentinelOne?**
 AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI\-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add\-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.
   

  

 We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:
   

  

**Equity \& Rewards**

**Time Off \& Wellbeing**

title: Analyst - Regulatory Reporting
description:
**Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
   

  

 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 62 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Analyst – Regulatory Reporting.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* This team is a global, cross\-asset\-class role that works closely with front\-to\-back stakeholders to ensure key controls are in place to reduce HSBC’s overall regulatory risk.
* The team are considered the ‘Control Owners for Over\-the counter and Exchange\-Traded Derivatives Trade \& Transaction Reporting and responsible for ensuring that HSBC’s various reporting obligations (HKMA, ASIC/MAS, MIFID, EMIR, SFTR, CFTC, CSA, SEC) are met in a timely and accurate fashion.
* Implement and monitor controls across exceptions, reconciliations, quality assurance and pairing \& matching. Mitigate under\-reporting, over\-reporting, and mis\-reporting risks identified by controls.
* Escalate identified issues and work with various stakeholders to implement strategic solutions. Create management information dashboards to highlight key performance indicators and risk indicators.
* Respond to counterparty queries and exchange information for accurate reporting. Manage audit and business queries within agreed Service Level Agreement response time.


**To Be Successful You Will**
* A degree in banking / finance / risk management with Understanding of end\-to\-end trade lifecycle and characteristics of typical OTC Derivative products.
* Strong foundation of risk management principles and understanding of controls framework. Awareness of the global regulatory landscape and key aspects of various Trade and Transactions Reporting regulations.

 \- Support case logging and ensure timely updates in the Fraud Incident Management (FIM) system, and manage end‑to‑end investigations to minimize losses and maximize recoveries.

 \- Monitor and action fraud alerts generated by the Enterprise Fraud Management (EFM) system in real\-time, and resolve queued alerts in accordance with defined scope and guidelines.
   

  

 \- Conduct preliminary investigations and take immediate preventive actions upon identifying or suspecting fraud to minimize potential losses (current and future) to the Bank.
   

  

 \- Liaise with internal teams to initiate preventive measures or recall funds to safeguard the Bank, customers, and third‑party interests.
   

  

 \- Accurately record all actions and decisions in the Intelligent Case Management System (ICMS).
   

  

 \- Ensure comprehensive investigation of alerts, covering all applicable scenarios/ rules through high‑quality, time‑bound reviews.
   

  

 \- Manage and validate fraud incidents reported, investigate them, and initiate immediate risk‑mitigation measures.

description:
**TITLE:** 
**Associate**
**DEPARTMENT:** 
**Homebuilder Solutions**
 In 2025, Blackstone established Brio Real Estate (“Brio”) as a portfolio company focused on real estate credit. Brio is a specialized global commercial real estate asset services platform that manages and supports Blackstone’s Real Estate Debt Strategies business (“BREDS”) across the globe. Today, BREDS has more than $77 billion in investor capital across high yield / opportunistic real estate credit funds, a publicly traded Mortgage REIT, CMBS securities and insurance capital. Brio is a sophisticated real estate credit solutions provider that enhances value for investors and supports BREDS across key functions, including asset management, transactions, capital markets, surveillance, portfolio management and legal \& compliance. Brio provides critical infrastructure and capabilities for BREDS to allow for effective investments and management of its global portfolio.
   

  

 Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager with more than $1 trillion in assets under management. Blackstone’s scale, with roughly 12,700 real estate assets and over 240 portfolio companies, enables them to invest in dynamic sectors positioned for long\-term growth. The firm seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by building strong businesses that deliver lasting value. Blackstone’s global investment strategies focus on real estate, private equity, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, credit, secondaries and hedge funds.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Brio Homebuilder Solutions finances production homebuilders and residential developers nationwide. We specialize in revolving lines of credit and acquisition, development, and construction (ADC) facilities that enable the development, construction, and sale of new homes in major U.S. metropolitan markets. Our clients typically deliver 150 to 200 homes annually or more, ranging from regional builders to multi‑market operators. We also finance master‑planned communities and stand‑alone residential developments.
   

  

 We are seeking an analytical professional to support the underwriting, portfolio management, and risk oversight of residential Acquisition \& Development (A\&D) and homebuilder lending portfolios. The role involves conducting financial and market analysis, evaluating builder performance, monitoring covenant compliance and portfolio risk, and supporting credit decision\-making throughout the loan lifecycle.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have strong financial analysis and credit skills, a solid understanding of residential land development and homebuilder finance, and the ability to identify emerging risks while providing actionable insights to support portfolio performance and risk management.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Portfolio and Risk Management
+ Data and Financial Analysis: Spread financial statements, standardize builder inventory reports, and calculate risk metrics.
+ Portfolio Monitoring: Assist in monitoring A\&D loans, borrowing bases, covenant compliance, and housing market metrics like starts and absorption.
+ Interpret and evaluate loan agreements, servicing agreements, and other legal documentation to support underwriting, asset management, and risk assessment activities.
+ Risk Management: Track market conditions and builder concentration, run stress tests, and recommend risk solutions.
+ Identify early warning signs of builder distress by tracking delayed lot development or slowing sales velocity.
+ Evaluate builder land pipelines, absorption paces, and lot take\-down schedules during the underwriting stage
+ Report Management: Streamline and consolidate separate reports into clear summaries for management.
+ Underwriting Support: Evaluate builder land pipelines, absorption pace, development schedules, and lot take\-down structures during underwriting and credit review processes.
+ IGA Administration: Maintain and update IGA extensions, ensuring timely tracking, documentation, and compliance with internal credit and portfolio management requirements.


**What You’ll Bring**
* MBA in Finance or bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Real Estate, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 3\-5 years of experience in commercial banking, real estate lending, credit analysis, portfolio management, underwriting, or a related financial services role.
* Strong understanding of residential land development, Acquisition \& Development (A\&D) lending, homebuilder finance, and real estate credit fundamentals.
* Experience spreading and analyzing financial statements, evaluating borrower performance, and assessing credit risk.
* Ability to review and interpret loan agreements, servicing agreements, guaranties, and other legal and credit documentation.
* Proficiency in analyzing builder inventory reports, borrowing bases, covenant compliance, and portfolio performance metrics.
* Experience preparing market analyses, evaluating project budgets, and validating data quality across pipelines and portfolio reporting.
* Understanding of housing market fundamentals, including absorption rates, housing starts, lot development cycles, and sales velocity trends.
* Ability to identify emerging portfolio risks and early warning indicators through financial, operational, and market analysis.
* Experience supporting underwriting and credit approval processes, including evaluation of land pipelines, development schedules, and lot take\-down structures.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial modeling, data analysis, and reporting.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills with the ability to present complex information in a clear and concise manner.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Demonstrated experience working with large production builders and complex, multi‑phase projects.
* Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative, team‑oriented environment.


**Good to Have**
* Experience with appraisal review, inspection processes, and loan servicing systems.
* Familiarity with borrowing‑base and collateral monitoring best practices.
* Knowledge of master‑planned community underwriting, horizontal and vertical development, and multi‑market portfolio oversight.
* Experience guiding junior team members and leading cross‑functional workstreams.


 In this role, you will safeguard credit quality, enhance portfolio performance, and help Brio deliver reliable, scalable capital to best‑in‑class homebuilders—supporting housing supply and community development across the U.S.

description:
About the Company Eton Solutions is an ERP software product (AtlasFive® and EtonAI™) and services company founded to handle the complexities of servicing Single Family Offices, Multi Family Offices, Wealth Owners, RIAs, Business Managers, Private Equity, Real Estate and Fund of Fund Firms globally. Eton Solutions flagship product, AtlasFive®, is a fully integrated, secure cloud\-native AI\-driven software, that holistically aggregates and manages all your liquid and alternative investment assets and data, reporting and workflow processes. For More details visit: https://eton\-solutions.com/
 



 Reporting Engineer — Power BI, Microsoft Fabric \& Azure Analytics
 



 Role Summary
 



 We are hiring a Reporting Engineer to join our Business Intelligence \& Reporting team and help build, maintain, and scale the reporting and analytics layer of the AtlasFive® platform. This is a hands\-on role focused on Power BI report development, Microsoft Fabric\-based data pipelines, and SQL Server\-backed data models, all running on Azure infrastructure. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across the reporting stack — from writing efficient SQL and Python to building performant Power BI datasets and Fabric pipelines — and is diligent about data accuracy, performance, and documentation.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 Power BI \& Reporting Development

 Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate reporting requirements into effective visualizations
 



 Microsoft Fabric \& Data Engineering

 Perform data validation, reconciliation, and troubleshooting of data quality issues across reporting pipelines

 Use KQL to query and analyze logs in Azure Monitor / Log Analytics for pipeline and platform troubleshooting
 



 Automation \& Scripting

 Write scripts in Python (and PowerShell where applicable) to automate data refresh, validation, and reporting workflows
 



 •
 



 Automate recurring reporting tasks and alerts to reduce manual effort

 Contribute to documentation of reporting pipelines, data dictionaries, and report catalogs

 3 – 4 years of hands\-on experience in BI/reporting engineering, data analytics, or related roles

 Strong hands\-on experience with Power BI reporting — report/dashboard development, data modeling, DAX
 



 •
 



 Experience with Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Dataflows, Pipelines, Notebooks)

 Proficiency in Python for data processing and automation

 Technical Skills

title: Sr. Manager/Manager - Supply Chain Analytics
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
   

  

**About Lilly**
*At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients.*
*We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world.*
*Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve.*
*We bring our best to this work because people depend on it.*
*If you’re driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.*
**About Your Role At Lilly**
*At Lilly, every function has a role in getting medicines to patients.*
*Some build the science.*
*Others build the organisation that makes the science possible.*
*At Lilly in Bengaluru, the Supply Chain function is the infrastructure that allows scientists, engineers, and commercial professionals to do the work that reaches patients.*
*Your work is part of that chain.*
**Job Description**
 This role is part of the Business Intelligence Center of Excellence (COE), a global team that leverages advanced analytics capabilities to enable the achievement of Global Supply Chain (GSC) objectives.
   

  

 This role will provide technical expertise across supply chain analytics, planning, and global logistics for manufacturing sites, affiliates, hubs, regions, and zones. Candidate requires a strong understanding of end\-to\-end supply chain processes combined with advanced analytical skills like statistical modelling, AI/ML and data engineering concepts.
   

  

 This role will lead and deliver high\-impact projects that enhance operational efficiency and support data\-driven decision\-making across the global supply chain. Responsibilities include driving cross\-functional collaboration, managing stakeholders, identifying and mitigating risks, and effectively communicating project status, milestones, and key deliverables.
   

  

 This role also contributes to supply chain transformation initiatives including NexGen programs and works closely with GSC teams to streamline operations through analytics and automation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Provide advanced analytical expertise to Global Supply Chain (GSC) stakeholders, with a strong focus on optimizing processes, systems, and tools used to manage products across complex supply networks.
* Design, develop, and deliver enterprise\-grade Power BI dashboards that enable real\-time visibility into key supply chain KPIs, including inventory health, service levels, and logistics performance across global operations.
* Translate complex and high\-volume supply chain data into clear, actionable insights, empowering stakeholders to make faster, data\-driven decisions.
* Enhance and modernize reporting solutions by improving data accuracy, usability, and self\-service capabilities — reducing manual effort while increasing stakeholder confidence and adoption.
* Lead root\-cause analysis and resolution of issues within reporting and analytics solutions to ensure reliability, continuity, and accuracy of business\-critical insights.
* Build and operationalize scalable ETL pipelines and robust semantic data models that integrate data across ERP, planning, and logistics systems.
* Support and contribute to strategic data initiatives, including EWM, TMS and Enterprise Data Lake (EDB), ensuring standardized, clean, and well\-governed data flows across platforms.
* Identify and implement automation opportunities for recurring and ad hoc data processes using tools such as Power Automate, Python, and SQL, reducing cycle time and manual dependencies.
* Act as the primary technical advisor to GSC stakeholders, providing guidance on supply chain systems, analytics tools, and end\-to\-end product flow management.
* Collaborate with global planners, operations teams, and IT partners to deliver cross\-functional analytics initiatives with measurable business impact.
* Proactively identify gaps in data, processes, and tools, and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and performance across supply networks.
* Develop optimization models and scenario\-planning solutions to support strategic decision\-making across affiliates, distribution networks, and manufacturing sites.


**Basic Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Data Science, or a related field.


**Experience**
* 5–10 years in supply chain analytics, planning, or a related domain.


**Language**
* Proficiency in English (required).


**Preferred Skills \& Experience**
* Experience in Pharma / Life Sciences; manufacturing site exposure is a plus.
* APICS / CSCP certification preferred.
* Strong expertise in data visualization and transformation tools: Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, DAX, Power Query.
* Hands\-on experience with ERP and planning systems: Kinaxis, SAP IBP, EWM, TMS.
* Advanced analytics skills using AI/ML, SQL, Python/R.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively in a global, matrixed organization.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical thinking, and attention to detail.
* Demonstrated stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* High level of initiative, ownership, and ability to lead teams and manage ambiguity.


*At Lilly, caring is not only what we do for patients.*
*It is how we work.*
*We believe the people who dedicate themselves to making medicines better deserve an environment that makes their lives better too, one where they are supported, respected, and given the space to do their best work.*
*This is not just a policy.*
*It is who we are.*
 Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace\-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.

As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take\-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175\+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.

Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.
   

  

 Join us and be part of the play!
   

  

**Position Overview**
 Zynga’s data science and analytics team uses our unique and expansive data to model and predict user behavior, making our games more personalized and more fun to play! We strive for a better understanding of our players which translates into challenges and features that delight them and increased social engagement within our games.
   

  

 Here’s where you would come in: identify and formalize problems to understand user behavior. Create systems and analyses to derive insights that change the studio’s world view. Be innovative, be creative, use every bit of that key commodity – data. Millions of people play Zynga games every day, so our data is tremendously rich and we have a lot of it!
   

  

 We will rely on you to communicate your findings to your peers – both technical and non\-technical. Your solutions to difficult problems will need to be demonstrably impactful, visual and maintainable. You will work with our game teams to put your models into production. **POSITION SUMMARY** 




 Join EarnIn's Analytics Engineering team for a 6\-month internship building the data foundation that powers business decisions, and the AI systems that make that data accessible to every analyst at EarnIn. You'll own meaningful end\-to\-end work across two connected workstreams \- data modeling and AI\-powered analytics\- under the guidance of senior analytics engineers. This position is based in Bengaluru, India, with two days a week in\-office required as part of our expanding site location, and is a 6\-month contract engagement with a start date in January 2027\.

* Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree (B.E., B.Tech., M.Tech., or equivalent) in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field from an Indian university

* Eagerness to learn and actively use AI\-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as part of your day\-to\-day workflow. This is a core expectation, not a nice\-to\-have.

 At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context\-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities \- AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real\-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.
   

  

 Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025\), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026\), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50\+ industries and 1,000\+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI\-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.
   

  

 If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more \- deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Glean is seeking an AI Data Analyst to help power the human evaluation system behind Glean’s AI product quality. This role sits at the centre of response quality, competitive benchmarking, and release readiness. You will evaluate AI outputs, label and categorize failure modes, maintain high\-quality benchmark data, and help ensure the datasets and evals we rely on are realistic, consistent, and tied to measurable product quality lift. This is a highly cross\-functional role. You will work closely with QA, Engineering, Product, and the evals team to convert ambiguous quality issues into structured data, actionable feedback, and repeatable quality signals.
   

  

**You Will**
* Run ongoing human labeling for priority AI workflows, including response quality, task success, MCP and tool use, end\-to\-end Cowork\-style workflows.
* Triage bad\-query reports, downvotes, escalations, and routed quality issues; categorize failure modes and feed clean analysis back to partner teams.
* Perform qualitative analysis to identify recurring patterns such as hallucinations, retrieval failures, tool\-use issues, weak grounding, and poor workflow completion.
* Follow and improve labeling guidelines and rubrics so judgments are consistent, realistic, and useful for model and product improvement.
* Maintain high\-quality labeled datasets, golden sets, and regression slices; monitor coverage, drift, leakage, and difficulty distribution.
* Participate in calibration exercises with human graders and validate LLM\-as\-a\-judge outputs against human labels to improve consistency and judge quality.
* Partner with engineers, PMs, QA, and eval owners on pre/post\-change quality reads, benchmark updates, and release\-readiness decisions.
* Contribute to recurring quality reporting by surfacing top failure modes, coverage gaps, quality shifts, and actionable recommendations.


**About You**

title: Channel Order Management & Analytics Leader (Manager).
description:
**At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.**
**Job Overview**
 The
 **Channel Order Management \& Analytics Leader** 
 is responsible for managing the overall health of the Channel organization's global open order book and leading the team supporting order management activities. This role plays a critical role within the Channel Supply Chain organization, ensuring seamless coordination between distribution partners and TE's internal Business Units (PBUs) and manufacturing plants.
   

  

 Channel operates in a unique supply chain environment where distribution partners, including Arrow, TTI, Mouser, Avnet, Heilind, and others, serve as customers, while TE's PBUs and plants act as internal suppliers. This position is accountable for driving the end\-to\-end supply chain flow between these stakeholders, ensuring operational excellence and customer satisfaction.
   

  

 The successful candidate will oversee and optimize a complex order management operation, improve supply chain visibility, and drive process excellence. In addition, the role will lead the transformation of current operational processes toward a more proactive, analytics\-driven, and automated operating model. This includes leveraging data, technology, and automation solutions to improve efficiency, scalability, accuracy, and decision\-making.
   

  

 The role requires a proven supply chain professional with the ability to operate effectively across all levels of the organization, from detailed operational execution and planner\-level problem solving to strategic decision\-making and executive stakeholder engagement.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibility**
**PILLAR 1 \- Own \& Run the Operation \- Order \& Supplier Management**
**Distributor\-Facing Order Health**
* Own the health of the Channel open order book, including order intake, confirmations, past\-due aging, exception aging, and OTIF delivery across 10\-14 analysts.
* Manage distributor backlog and exceptions, including past\-due orders, unconfirmed lines, blocked orders, and expedites.
* Support distributor\-specific supply chain activities, including drop\-ship and stock orders, DTAM/design\-registration demand, inventory pulls, and allocation commitments.
* Champion the TE Customer Value Proposition (CVP) to improve customer and distributor experience.
* Ensure SAP execution discipline, including schedule lines, ATP, recommit dates, ABCON/Ship Note validation, and Late Reason Codes.


**Internal Supplier Management \& Collaboration**
* Own the Channel\-to\-BU supplier scorecard, including confirmation adherence, lead\-time compliance, fill rates, and recovery performance.
* Establish recurring reviews with PBU planners, schedulers, and supply planning teams.
* Build collaborative relationships with BUs and plants to proactively identify and resolve constraints.
* Translate supply constraints into distributor impact and drive mitigation plans.
* Act as the escalation bridge between Channel, BUs, Customer Care, and distributors.

title: Strategic Analytics Associate
description:
**Job Description**
 As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient. You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks, and using your expert judgement to solve real\-world challenges that impact our company, customers and communities. Our culture in Risk Management and Compliance is all about thinking outside the box, challenging the status quo, and striving to be best\-in\-class.
   

  

 As a Strategic Analytics Associate in Business Banking Risk, you will generate data‑driven insights and recommendations that inform strategy development, implementation, and performance monitoring across the Business Banking portfolio. You'll transform complex datasets into actionable management information, design and test strategies that balance growth and credit risk, and maintain robust controls and documentation to ensure an audit‑ready environment. This opportunity offers high visibility, cross‑functional collaboration, and the chance to influence outcomes across the credit lifecycle—from acquisition and underwriting through portfolio management, collections, and recoveries.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Conduct thoughtful analysis of borrowers, their demographics, and risk/profit performance with the firm's products.
* Generate strategic recommendations for strategy development based on quantitative analytics and business intuition. Strategies are optimized to maximize profitability while minimizing risk.
* Develop and maintain periodic reporting and analytics on key metrics to provide management with emerging trends including (but not limited to) volumes, modification/settlement rates and recovery rates of delinquent accounts.
* Acquire an understanding of the operational processes (i.e. manual underwriting, portfolio management, collections, etc.) which will aid in understanding past due account collection performance drivers.
* Conduct pre\-implementation and post\-implementation testing \& analysis to ensure strategic changes produce expected impacts.
* Contribute to the team's ‘audit\-ready' state by keeping organized documentation, following established control processes, and developing draft responses to internal audit and regulatory questions.
* Identify, evaluate, interpret and leverage complex internal and external data and develop analytical solutions to enhance risk strategies.
* Conduct adhoc analytics and contribute to various projects representing Risk Management.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills**
* Bachelor's or Master's in Engineering, Statistics, Econometrics, Operations Research, Mathematics (or equivalent quantitative field)
* Strong SAS/R/Python and SQL programming skills and Advanced Word, PowerPoint, and Excel skills
* 5\+ years of experience in Business Analysis, Consulting, Data Analytics, Risk Strategy, or related Financial Analysis
* Ability to query large amounts of data and transform the raw data into actionable management information
* Familiarity with risk analytic techniques and strong problem solving skills
* Demonstrated excellent written and oral communication skills to clearly present analytical findings and make business recommendations and prepare executive level communications.
* High degree of initiative, self\-direction, and excellent project management skills to manage competing priorities under tight deadlines
* Proven ability to collaborate and build strong partnerships.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills**
* Prior experience of working in in strategy / policy roles for persona;/business loans
* Intellectually curious and driven to identify meaningful insights using a data guided approach
* Strong knowledge of debt collection regulations and practices
* Experience delivering recommendations to management


**ABOUT US**
 JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
   

  

 We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our Consumer \& Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most\-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.
   

  

 Risk Management helps the firm understand, manage and anticipate risks in a constantly changing environment. The work covers areas such as evaluating country\-specific risk, understanding regulatory changes and determining credit worthiness. Risk Management provides independent oversight and maintains an effective control environment.
