title: Principal Data Analyst
description:
Back to jobs
   

  

 Principal Data Analyst
   

  

 Bangalore, India
   

  

****About Ethos****
 Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three\-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
   

  

****About The Role****
 Ethos is a data\-driven company, and analytics is at the heart of how we make decisions. We are looking for a
 **Principal Data Analyst** 
 who will own and drive the
 **data foundations and self\-serve analytics strategy** 
 for the company. This role will be responsible for designing and maintaining the systems, models, and tools that serve as our single source of truth, while empowering stakeholders to independently access and act on insights.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has a proven track record of
 **building data systems at scale** 
 and
 **driving adoption of self\-serve analytics** 
 . This role requires a rare combination of vision and hands\-on execution: you’ll set the direction for how data is modeled, monitored, and consumed — and also roll up your sleeves to build, validate, and ship solutions. You’ll also explore opportunities to bring
 **AI into analytics workflows** 
 , enabling faster, more intuitive self\-serve access to insights across the business.
   

  

****Duties And Responsibilities:****
* Data Foundations: Design, build, and validate event\-based foundational data models to serve as the single source of truth for funnels, experiments, and core business metrics.
* Self\-Serve Enablement: Build scalable datasets, dashboards, and monitoring systems in tools like Amplitude and Mode to allow teams to self\-serve insights.
* AI Integration: Identify and implement AI\-driven capabilities to enhance analytics workflows, improve discoverability, and reduce dependency on manual analyst support.
* Reliability \& Trust: Establish monitoring, alerting, and documentation to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability of all core metrics.
* End\-to\-End Ownership: Scope, design, build, validate, and deploy analytics solutions — from raw data pipelines to executive\-facing dashboards.
* Adoption \& Impact: Partner with stakeholders to understand their top use cases, deliver raw datasets and clean metrics, and ensure broad adoption of self\-serve tools.
* Vision \& Strategy: Anticipate future needs, identify gaps, and define scalable solutions that raise the bar for the analytics function.


****Qualifications And Skills:****
* 8\+ years of experience building and scaling data models, pipelines, and self\-serve analytics systems.
* Expert\-level SQL and strong experience with DBT or equivalent transformation frameworks.
* Hands\-on experience with BI/self\-serve tools such as Amplitude, Mode, or Looker.
* Deep understanding of event\-based data modeling and instrumentation best practices.
* Strong experience building monitoring and alerting for data reliability.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable insights for non\-technical stakeholders.
* High bar for data quality and accuracy; detail\-oriented with strong validation practices.
* Proven track record of driving adoption of self\-serve analytics across teams.
* Experience with AI/ML tools to support analytics workflows is a strong plus.

**AON IS IN THE BUSINESS OF BETTER DECISIONS**
 At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.
   

  

 As an organization, we are committed as one firm to our purpose, united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.
   

  

**Information About The Business**
 Aon Reinsurance Solutions is the world’s leading reinsurance intermediary and full\-service capital advisor. Reinsurance Solutions Analytics offers clients industry\-leading Catastrophe Management, Impact Forecasting, Rating Agency Practice, Product Development and Research, Actuarial \& ReMetrica support.
   

  

**General Description Of Role**
 Assist onshore catastrophe management managers in assessing catastrophe risks, carrying out sensitivity studies, and providing added analytics to clients.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* As part of the Catastrophe Management team, Run catastrophe modeling software for client and prospect portfolio risk analyses.
* Prepare property insurance policy data for catastrophe risk analysis using Microsoft Access, SQL Query Analyzer and other data conversion tools.
* Use proprietary software to design and manage catastrophe reinsurance programs.
* Respond to brokers, clients, and reinsurers on issues and questions relating to risk analysis for natural and human\-made catastrophes.
* Provide real\-time loss estimates of actual catastrophic events around the world.
* Prepare and send catastrophe risk assessment data to reinsurers and participate in reinsurance market calls.
* Assist clients in the understanding of catastrophe risks, sensitivity studies, and added analytics based on catastrophe model results.


**Skills/competencies Required**
* Practical experience with data analysis/clean up/validation whether in a work or academic setting.
* Proven analytical skills. Prior analytical and problem\-solving experience from academic and/or business environment.
* Strong organizational skills including the ability to manage multiple assignments, work well with minimal supervision and meet deadlines in a timely manner.
* Ability to think strategically and analytically as well as work independently and take initiative.
* Potential for temporary or permanent relocation to other Reinsurance Solutions offices.
* Relevant work/ internship experience.
* Confident and determined individual; has Can\-Do attitude; Ability to work in teams and do multi\-tasking; ability to maintain good interpersonal relationships.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate well with others externally and internally. Well\-rounded communication skills and ability to interact with variety of audiences.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft products, with intermediate proficiency in Access, and working knowledge of Excel strongly preferred. SQL experience a definite plus.

 Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips colleagues to learn, share and grow, helping them achieve their fullest potential. As a result, Aon colleagues are more connected, more relevant and more valued.

title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
**Senior BI Analyst** 




  





**Role Overview**




 The Senior BI Analyst plays a critical role in driving supply chain analytics by building key tools or applications and owning end\-to\-end reporting, data modeling, and data pipeline development that lead to insights and automations based on deep business domain knowledge that drive user efficiency. This role works closely with Business, Supply Chain, cross functional partners such as MP\&A, Finance, Merchandising and IT teams to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions and actionable insights.
 



 The individual is expected to independently manage projects, deliver tools/applications, datasets, build robust reporting layers, and ensure data reliability across systems. In addition to executing analytics, the Sr. BI Analyst contributes to improving system and data architecture, standardizing KPIs, improving data quality and enabling self\-service analytics.
 



 This role acts as a
 **“Builder”** 
 , strengthening the analytics foundation while mentoring junior analysts and improving business user effectiveness and productivity.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities (Day\-to\-Day)**



* **Analytics \& Reporting:** 
 Design, develop, and manage supply chain tools, optimizations, dashboards and reports using tools such as SQL, Snowflake, MicroStrategy, Python, and Sigma. Ensure accurate tracking of supply chain KPIs and provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
* Answer business problems using a mix of Explanatory and Exploratory Analysis and Storytelling using Visualization.
* Present findings to stakeholders in an easily consumable manner.
* **Dashboard Maintenance \& Monitoring:** 
 Design, initiate, maintain and enhance reporting assets based on converting data into insights. Proactively identify anomalies or data inconsistencies.
* **Data Engineering \& ETL:** 
 Develop and optimize SQL\-based data pipelines in Snowflake or other tools. Structure datasets for scalability, performance, and reusability. Architect and implement scalable data pipeline solutions to optimize analytical frameworks and accelerate innovation and business insight
* **Data Management \& Validation:** 
 Collect, clean, and validate data from Enterprise Systems (e.g., SAP/Centric/Salesforce/Line Planning) and other sources.
* **Domain Expertise** 
 : Work with business and product managers to influence tool and analytics roadmap to build capabilities ahead of business needs. Keep up to date understanding of business usage, the business processes it supports, data meaning and future capabilities required by the business to drive competitive advantage
* **Data Quality \& Governance**
* Participate in data governance activities, including dataset documentation, metadata maintenance, and data quality checks.
* Identify data issues and support root cause analysis efforts in partnership with senior team members.
* Help maintain curated datasets and support publishing content to the enterprise data catalog.
* **Semantic Layer Development:** 
 Lead the creation of standardized data models and semantic layers to enable self\-service analytics.
* **Enterprise Integration Support:** 
 Integrate data from Enterprise Systems to ensure seamless data flow, improved visibility, and consistency across business functions. Work with IT organization to ensure data dictionary, data usage and corporate standards are met.
* **Business Application Development:** 
 Leverage low\-code tools such as Sigma, Salesforce, Power Automate and Python to build lightweight applications that improve internal workflows and reduce manual effort. Continue to refine existing processes and tool to reduce user friction, improve efficiency and performance
* **Innovation:** 
 Leverages cutting edge technologies to creatively solve business challenges. Stays current with technology innovation.
* **Cross\-functional Enablement:** 
 Partner with business teams to drive data adoption and lead KPI definitions and usage.



  





**Skills \& Qualifications**



* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Supply Chain, Analytics, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 
 5\+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analysis, or Supply Chain Analytics.
* **Technical Skills:**
* Strong foundation in
 **SQL** 
 (joins, aggregations, basic query optimization).
* Advanced Excel Skills.
* Experience in
 **Data Warehousing** 
 and tools such as Snowflake (or similar platforms like Databricks/Hadoop).
* Proficiency in BI tools (MicroStrategy, Power BI, Tableau, Sigma)
* Proficient in
 **Python** 
 (Pandas, basic scripting, Flask) or any programming language for data handling and scripting.
* Proficient with
 **low\-code/no\-code tools** 
 like Sigma, Streamlit, or Power Apps.
* Strong expertise in
 **data cleaning and validation techniques** 
 .
* **Data Engineering:** 
 Experience in ETL pipelines and performance optimization
* **Computer Science Fundamentals** 
 :
* Strong programming fundamentals, object oriented programming, and algorithms
* Strong experience with data modeling principles and relational database theory \& normalization techniques
* Ability to apply data structures and appropriate usage (arrays, lists, dictionaries, trees)
* **Analytical Skills:**
* Ability to work with large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies.
* Strong attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy and quality.
* Advanced understanding of KPIs and metrics, preferably in a supply chain or operations context.
* Statistical knowledge that can be applied to metrics and machine learning algorithms.
* **Business \& Functional Understanding:**
* Experience with supply chain, manufacturing, apparel or retail operations.
* Understanding of Enterprise systems such as SAP or similar platforms.
* Exposure to Product Development, Order Management, Sourcing/ Procurement, Inventory, Warehousing preferred.
* **Soft Skills:**
* Good problem\-solving and logical thinking ability.
* Strong communication skills to collaborate with cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to manage tasks independently and follow structured processes (SOP\-driven environment)
* Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast\-paced, data\-driven environment.
* Prior experience mentoring junior analysts.
* **Preferred: Agentic AI \& Automation Skills**
* Knowledge of Agentic AI concepts, including AI systems that can autonomously plan, execute multi‑step tasks, and interact with tools or data sources.
* Experience using AI copilots or agents (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, OpenAI\-based agents, workspace automation tools) to streamline analysis, documentation, or workflow orchestration.
* Understanding of how AI agents integrate with data ecosystems, such as connecting to SQL warehouses, APIs, MCP, RAG or analytics tools to retrieve, transform, or explain data.
* Experience evaluating AI\-generated insights, including validating outputs for accuracy, bias, completeness, and alignment with business logic.
* Interest in exploring emerging AI capabilities (e.g., autonomous reporting agents, automated data quality checks, or self\-service analytics through conversational interfaces).

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Big Box
description:
**Work Schedule**
 Standard Office Hours (40/wk)
   

  

**Environmental Conditions**
 Office
   

  

 As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
   

  

**Role Summary**
* We are seeking a highly analytical Supply Chain Analyst (Band 7\) to support end\-to\-end supply chain analytics across the CMD LSMS/AAT (Big box instrument) portfolio. This role will enable data\-driven decision\-making through advanced analytics, reporting, and cross\-functional collaboration, cutting across supply planning, managing material issues / shortages, driving inventory and distribution analytics.


**How will you make an impact?**
* On the Chromatography and Mass Spectrometry team, you will aid our supply chain to manufacture innovative instruments, consumables, and software solutions for customers working in the analytical sciences (routine testing markets) and scientific research. Our complete workflow solutions enable productivity and efficiency for customers performing food and beverage testing and manufacturing, environmental and industrial testing, biopharma QA/QC, toxicology, and anti\-doping.


**What will you do?**
* Support SIOP/S\&OE execution through robust analytics, actionable insights, and standardized KPI/performance reporting
* Analyze material shortages to identify root causes and drive mitigation strategies; partner with suppliers to improve forecast alignment and enhance supply risk visibility
* Deliver E\&O inventory analytics and reporting to support business unit inventory optimization and working capital goals
* Extract, interpret, and analyze SAP data using key T\-codes (e.g., MD04, MD07, MB52, VA05, COOIS) to support operational and strategic decision\-making
* Conduct network and distribution analytics focused on service levels, transportation cost, lead times, and inventory positioning to support stocking strategy decisions across the business unit
* Support supply chain transformation initiatives, including footprint optimization, BOM analytics, SKU rationalization, and operational efficiency programs
* Partner with the master data team to identify data integrity issues, recommend corrective actions, and improve overall data accuracy and governance across supply chain systems


**How will you get here?**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, or related field


**Experience**
* 5–8 years of relevant supply chain analytics / planning experience
* Strong expertise across 2\+ areas: demand, supply, production, inventory, or distribution
* Expertise in SAP ERP system, advanced Excel, SQL, and data visualization tools (Power BI/Tableau) to develop dashboards, KPIs, and executive\-level reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to synthesize large, complex datasets into actionable business insights and present recommendations to operations and senior leadership teams.


**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities**
* Analytical and statistical skills including the ability to develop and report metrics, develop predictive models and prescriptive analytics.
* Experience with advanced planning systems (a plus)
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English – shown through both written and spoken communication.
* Strong analytical and stakeholder management skills

Back to jobs
   

  

 Senior/Staff Product Analyst, Consumer
   

  

 Bangalore, India
   

  

****About Ethos****
 Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three\-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
   

  

****About The Role****
 This is a high\-impact role for an analyst who wants to own the data behind a core part of our Consumer business and use it to change what gets built. You'll partner directly with product, design, and engineering to drive how we grow the direct\-to\-consumer funnel — from the moment someone lands on the site, through quote and approval, to activating their policy.
   

  

 It starts with a real understanding of our customers, our funnel, and the levers that move conversion and retention. That understanding is what makes your analysis worth acting on. You use it to find the highest\-leverage questions, spot opportunities the team hasn't seen yet, and bring recommendations that change roadmap decisions rather than just describe what happened.
   

  

 The AI infrastructure we've built changes what this role looks like day to day. Mechanical analysis is faster than it has ever been, which frees you to spend your time on the parts that need judgment: framing the right question, validating what the tools produce, and drawing the conclusion the business should act on. We're further along on this than most companies, and we're still writing the playbook — you'll help shape it.
   

  

 You go deep in analytics and experimentation on your product area, and AI gives you the reach to cover more ground than a traditional analyst.
   

  

****Duties And Responsibilities:****
* Own the analytics for your product area. You partner with PMs across the Consumer funnel — landing page, quote flow, onboarding, approval, and activation — to define success metrics, find where users drop off, and make sure decisions are grounded in data. PMs make different calls because you're in the room.
* Be accountable for outcomes, not output. You're measured on the business impact of the decisions your analysis influences — conversion, approval rate, activation, retention — not the number of analyses you produce. You connect findings across experiments and cohorts to surface patterns a single analysis would miss.
* Own experimentation for your area. Design, instrument, and interpret A/B and multivariate tests — from CTA and quote\-flow changes to eligibility and onboarding — with the statistical rigor to separate real lift from noise, and help raise the quality and speed of how the team runs experiments.
* Build deep customer and funnel understanding. Develop a rich picture of how different segments behave — return visitors, demographic cohorts, traffic sources — and turn it into product recommendations that improve conversion for each group.
* Own the quality of AI\-assisted analysis. Our tools pull data, read configs, and draft analysis. You use them to move faster, and you own validating and sharpening what they produce. Human judgment over AI output, always.
* Make insights self\-serve. Build dashboards and frameworks that let PMs and leaders answer their own questions, and communicate findings in clear narratives that drive alignment and action, including with senior stakeholders.


****Qualifications And Skills:****
* 7\+ years in product analytics, growth analytics, or data science, with real impact in high\-growth, consumer\-facing environments.
* A track record of changing what a product team built or prioritized — not just reporting on what shipped.
* You don't wait for a fully specified ask. You see the gap, frame the question, build the answer, and land it with the right audience.
* Expert SQL, and fluency with a modern analytics stack — Snowflake and a product analytics tool like Amplitude. Python (or R) and dbt are a plus.
* Deep experience designing and interpreting experiments and applying statistical rigor — regression, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing.
* Daily use of AI tools in your analytics workflow, with a clear\-eyed sense of where they accelerate the work, where they get it wrong, and where your own judgment is non\-negotiable.
* Strong communication and storytelling — able to turn complex analysis into clear, strategic narratives for PMs, engineers, and executives.

****Duties And Responsibilities:****
* Own the analytics for your product area. You partner with PMs across the Consumer funnel — landing page, quote flow, onboarding, approval, and activation — to define success metrics, find where users drop off, and make sure decisions are grounded in data. PMs make different calls because you're in the room.
* Be accountable for outcomes, not output. You're measured on the business impact of the decisions your analysis influences — conversion, approval rate, activation, retention — not the number of analyses you produce. You connect findings across experiments and cohorts to surface patterns a single analysis would miss.
* Own experimentation for your area. Design, instrument, and interpret A/B and multivariate tests — from CTA and quote\-flow changes to eligibility and onboarding — with the statistical rigor to separate real lift from noise, and help raise the quality and speed of how the team runs experiments.
* Build deep customer and funnel understanding. Develop a rich picture of how different segments behave — return visitors, demographic cohorts, traffic sources — and turn it into product recommendations that improve conversion for each group.
* Own the quality of AI\-assisted analysis. Our tools pull data, read configs, and draft analysis. You use them to move faster, and you own validating and sharpening what they produce. Human judgment over AI output, always.
* Make insights self\-serve. Build dashboards and frameworks that let PMs and leaders answer their own questions, and communicate findings in clear narratives that drive alignment and action, including with senior stakeholders.


****Qualifications And Skills:****
* 7\+ years in product analytics, growth analytics, or data science, with real impact in high\-growth, consumer\-facing environments.
* A track record of changing what a product team built or prioritized — not just reporting on what shipped.
* You don't wait for a fully specified ask. You see the gap, frame the question, build the answer, and land it with the right audience.
* Expert SQL, and fluency with a modern analytics stack — Snowflake and a product analytics tool like Amplitude. Python (or R) and dbt are a plus.
* Deep experience designing and interpreting experiments and applying statistical rigor — regression, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing.
* Daily use of AI tools in your analytics workflow, with a clear\-eyed sense of where they accelerate the work, where they get it wrong, and where your own judgment is non\-negotiable.
* Strong communication and storytelling — able to turn complex analysis into clear, strategic narratives for PMs, engineers, and executives.

title: Power BI SME
description:
**Role Summary**
 Avanade India’s Data \& AI practice is looking for a Power BI Consultant who can take a reporting requirement from the first conversation with a business user through to a published, refreshing, secured dashboard in production. This is a hands\-on build role with real client exposure — you will gather requirements, design the data model, write the DAX, build the visuals and own the solution through go\-live.
   

  

 We are looking for someone who thinks about the model before the chart. Strong DAX and a clean star schema are what make a dashboard fast, accurate and maintainable, and this role is weighted towards that discipline as much as towards visual design. Programming exposure — particularly Python for data analysis — is a welcome addition and will be supported and developed in the role, but strong Power BI craft is what matters most.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Gather and clarify reporting requirements with business and IT stakeholders — understand the questions being asked, the decisions they support, the underlying data sources and the definitions behind each metric.
* Translate requirements into a solution design: data model, KPI and measure definitions, report structure, navigation, security model and refresh approach.
* Design and build robust Power BI data models — star schema design, fact and dimension tables, relationships and cardinality, date/calendar tables, hierarchies and role\-playing dimensions.
* Write and optimise DAX — measures, calculated columns and tables, time intelligence, variables, context transition, and performance tuning of slow measures.
* Build and maintain Power Query (M) transformations — source connections, cleansing, shaping, merges and appends, query folding awareness, parameters and incremental refresh setup.
* Develop KPI dashboards and analytical reports that are visually clear and decision\-oriented — appropriate visual selection, consistent formatting, drill\-through, bookmarks, tooltips and accessible design.
* Implement row\-level security — role design, DAX filter expressions, static and dynamic RLS patterns — and validate it thoroughly before release.
* Configure and manage Power BI Service operations: workspaces, apps, dataset publishing, scheduled refresh, on\-premises data gateway configuration, refresh failure troubleshooting and access management.
* Profile, validate and reconcile data against source systems — using SQL, and Python where you have it — to investigate anomalies and support analysis that goes beyond the dashboard.
* Write and tune SQL against source systems and data warehouses to extract, validate and shape data for reporting.
* Test and validate reports — reconciliation against source, measure accuracy checks, performance testing on realistic data volumes, and UAT support with business users.
* Document solutions — data dictionaries, measure definitions, model documentation and handover material — and support end users through training and adoption.
* Follow deployment and governance practice: workspace lifecycle, deployment pipelines, version control, naming standards and dataset certification where applicable.
* Contribute to reusable practice assets — report templates, DAX pattern libraries, theme files and accelerators.


**Qualifications**
**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 3–6 years of hands\-on experience building and delivering Power BI solutions in a client or enterprise environment.
* Strong DAX skills — measures, time intelligence, filter and row context, CALCULATE patterns, and the ability to debug and optimise existing DAX.
* Strong Power Query / M skills for data transformation, including handling multiple and messy source systems.
* Solid data modelling capability — dimensional modelling, star schema design, relationship and granularity decisions, and understanding of why model design drives report performance.
* Proven experience designing and building KPI dashboards that business users actually use, with attention to layout, clarity and interaction design.
* Hands\-on implementation of row\-level security, including dynamic RLS driven by a user/security table.
* Practical experience with Power BI Service administration: workspaces, apps, scheduled refresh, data gateway setup and refresh troubleshooting.
* Experience across the full delivery cycle — requirement gathering, solution design, build, testing, UAT and go\-live support — not only report building to a handed\-over spec.
* Good SQL — joins, aggregations, window functions and query optimisation basics.
* Ability to engage business stakeholders directly, ask clarifying questions and explain technical constraints in plain language.
* Attention to detail on data accuracy, with the habit of reconciling and validating numbers before they reach a user.


**Preferred / Good To Have**
* Programming exposure and data analysis in Python — pandas and numpy for data manipulation, basic visualisation and readable analysis scripts. Good to have rather than essential; an interest in building this skill is valued.
* Microsoft certification PL\-300 (Power BI Data Analyst) or DP\-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer).
* Exposure to Microsoft Fabric — Lakehouse, Warehouse, Dataflows Gen2, semantic models and Direct Lake.
* Experience with Azure data services — Azure SQL, Synapse, Data Factory or Databricks — feeding Power BI datasets.
* Familiarity with Power BI performance tooling: DAX Studio, Tabular Editor, Performance Analyzer and Best Practice Analyzer.
* Experience with paginated reports (Power BI Report Builder) or Power BI Embedded.
* Exposure to Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate) for embedded and write\-back scenarios.
* Awareness of data governance and cataloguing — Microsoft Purview, sensitivity labels and dataset certification.
* Version control and CI/CD experience for Power BI (Git integration, deployment pipelines).
* Domain exposure in one or more of manufacturing, BFSI, consumer goods, energy or healthcare reporting.

title: Senior Pricing Analyst - Market Intelligence
description:
**Company Overview**
**JB Poindexter (India) Private Limited** 
 is a subsidiary of
 **J.B.** 
**Poindexter \& Co., Inc.** 
 a privately held diversified manufacturing company forecasting $2\.4B in annual revenue and 8,000 team members in 2024\. The eight operating subsidiaries, covering over 50 locations, are engaged in the production of commercial truck bodies, step\-vans, utility trucks, funeral coaches, limousines, pickup truck bed enclosures, precision machining, and expandable foam plastic packaging. For more information, visit www.jbpoindexter.com
   

  

**JB Poindexter (India) Private Limited** 
 is the captive shared services unit of the
 **J.B. Poindexter \& Co., Inc.** 
 The company, wholly owned by J. B. Poindexter \& Co., Inc. \& is headquartered in Houston, Texas, USA.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Strengthen enterprise pricing maturity by building a structured, repeatable capability for market, competitor, and industry intelligence. This role provides accurate, organized external data and reporting to support corporate pricing teams.
   

  

**Position Responsibilities**
* Competitive Pricing Intelligence
* Collect and track competitor pricing, promotions, and discount activity across channels and regions.
* Maintain competitive price indexes and benchmarking datasets.
* Flag notable competitive changes for review by corporate pricing teams.


**2** 
**. Market \& Industry Monitoring**
* Monitor industry trends, cost drivers, regulatory updates, and macroeconomic factors relevant to pricing.
* Summarize key developments in standardized reporting formats.
* Maintain a structured, well‑organized market intelligence repository.
* External Data Integration
* Integrate competitive and market data into dashboards, price books, and recurring reports.
* Coordinate with Data \& Analytics resources to automate data collection and external data feeds.
* Validate data quality and ensure alignment with internal pricing structures.
* Reporting \& Insight Support
* Prepare recurring competitive and market intelligence reports for corporate pricing team.
* Highlight meaningful changes or anomalies in competitor or market activity.
* Provide clean, validated datasets for deeper analysis by global pricing stakeholders.
* Cross‑Functional Support
* Work with Sales, Marketing, Product, to gather external inputs and ensure consistent intelligence flow.
* Follow global pricing governance standards for documentation, data handling, and reporting.


**Education**
**Position Qualifications \& Requirements:**
* Bachelor’s in business, Economics, Marketing, Data Analytics, or related field
* Coursework in market research, analytics, or competitive intelligence preferred


**Experience**
* 5\- 7 years in market research, competitive intelligence, pricing support, or data analysis
* Experience collecting and organizing competitive pricing data from public sources
* Familiarity with industry reports, trade publications, and market monitoring tools
* Experience in preparing recurring intelligence reports for internal teams
* Back‑office or shared‑services experience preferred


**Certification / License (Preferred)**
* Market Research certifications (e.g., Insights Association, Coursera Market Research)
* Google Data Analytics or similar analytics certificates
* Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt (for process discipline)


**Skills And Abilities**
* Strong Excel for data organization and analysis
* Experience with Power BI/Tableau for simple dashboards or visual summaries
* Ability to manage structured data repositories
* Basic understanding of pricing structures and competitive benchmarking
* High attention to detail and accuracy in data collection
* Strong organizational skills for maintaining structured intelligence repositories
* Clear written communication for summaries and reporting
* Ability to follow standardized processes and work independently
* Comfortable supporting global teams across time zones


**Supervisory Responsibilities**
* None


**Work Environment**
* Professional office environment
* Sedentary work with extended periods of computer use
* Occasional work in warehouse/manufacturing plant.


 Must be able to wear required Personal Protective equipment (PPE)
   

  

**Code Of Ethics**
**JB Poindexter (India) Private Limited** 
 , requires the highest standard of ethics in all business dealings, with customers, suppliers, advisors, employees, and authorities. This position shall actively ensure that his/her own activities and those of all employees within the project meet this obligation. JBPCO critical standards and procedures related to expected conduct are detailed on the company website. This position is expected to be familiar with these policies and ensure that they are implemented in all areas of control.

title: SAP Supply Chain Planning Analyst
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3\.7 billion in revenue, its first billion\-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27\. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology \- hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.
   

  

 This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 As an SAP SCM Analyst at Everpure, you will drive the operational precision of our global demand planning and Sales \& Operations Planning (S\&OP) cycles using SAP IBP Demand Planning. Partnering closely with the Plan to Forecast Lead and global commercial planners, you will transform historical sales data and market inputs into high\-quality baseline statistical forecasts. Your meticulous oversight of forecasting models and supply chain data directly minimizes forecast error and optimizes global inventory readiness. By ensuring an accurate demand signal, you empower Everpure to seamlessly meet customer requirements worldwide.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Statistical Forecast Engineering: Own the generation and continuous refinement of baseline statistical forecasts within SAP IBP, leveraging data\-driven inputs to establish a highly reliable predictive foundation for our monthly commercial planning cycles.
* Forecast Performance Tracking: Execute and analyze critical forecast error metrics (including MAPE, WMAPE, and bias) to isolate structural variances, enabling cross\-functional teams to pinpoint root causes and continuously improve plan attainment.
* Master Data \& View Architecture Maintenance: Govern demand planning master data integrity across product hierarchies, location assignments, and planning segments, utilizing SAP IBP Fiori interfaces and Excel Add\-ins to keep configuration maps completely synchronized with corporate growth.
* Consensus \& S\&OP Cycle Facilitation: Streamline the consensus planning workflow by consolidating strategic commercial inputs from sales and marketing, cross\-checking data quality, and manufacturing executive\-ready S\&OP planning packs for critical alignment reviews.


**What You Bring**
* Demand Planning \& Forecasting Expertise: 3\+ years of professional hands\-on experience in demand planning, forecasting, or supply chain analysis, showcasing a strong grasp of quantitative statistical modeling and core inventory optimization frameworks.
* SAP IBP Technical Capabilities: Proven practical proficiency working daily inside SAP IBP Demand Planning (or SAP APO DP) environments, with strong technical comfort navigating IBP Excel Add\-ins and Fiori\-based planning views.
* Data Lifecycle \& Matrix Analysis: Exceptional analytical capability to interpret complex datasets, manage multi\-layered product structures, and cleanly maintain process documentation within a highly structured, deadline\-driven global planning calendar.
* Stakeholder Alignment \& Collaboration: Excellent communication skills to interface with diverse global business partners across sales, marketing, and logistics, ensuring data inputs remain accurate and consensus cycles proceed smoothly.
* Location Requirement: We are primarily an in\-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.


**What You Can Expect From Us**
* Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
* Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!

title: CSI Analytics - Synthetic Data Technical Analyst
description:

**CSI Analytics – Synthetic Data Technical Analyst**
**Job Details**
**Position Title :** 
 CSI Analytics – Synthetic Data Technical Analyst
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 The Synthetic Data Technical Analyst (Senior Associate) will be responsible for supporting the delivery, implementation, validation, and operation of Synthetic Data solutions across the organization. Working as part of the Synthetic Data Service team, the role will focus on generating, testing, validating, and maintaining Synthetic Data assets that support analytics, AI development, testing, performance testing, integration testing, business innovation, and secure data sharing.
   

  

 The successful candidate will possess strong technical capabilities across Python development, SQL, Data Engineering, Machine Learning, Statistical Analysis, and Data Modelling disciplines. The role requires a hands\-on technical practitioner responsible for analysing source datasets, implementing generation logic, validating outputs, and supporting the development of reusable Synthetic Data generation frameworks.
   

  

 Working under the guidance of the Synthetic Data Technical Lead, the analyst will contribute to the delivery of Synthetic Data engagements from requirements gathering through implementation, validation, documentation, and support.
   

  

**Key Role And Responsibilities**
 This Synthetic Data Technical Analyst will be responsible for delivering scalable, secure, and high quality synthetic data solutions to meet exceptional client and internal stakeholder expectations. Standard work includes but is not limited to:
   

  

**Synthetic Data Solution Delivery**
* Analyse source datasets, schemas, relationships, dimensions, distributions, and business rules required for Synthetic Data generation.
* Develop and maintain Python, SQL, and automation scripts supporting Synthetic Data generation and validation.
* Implement rule\-based, statistical, simulation, and machine\-learning\-driven generation techniques.
* Support the creation and maintenance of reusable generation blueprints and framework components.
* Generate and validate Synthetic Data datasets for testing, analytics, AI, and business innovation use cases.


**Synthetic Data Engineering \& Validation**
* Support modelling of facts, dimensions, hierarchies, relationships, and business rules within Synthetic Data solutions.
* Execute data profiling, statistical analysis, distribution testing, and validation activities.
* Validate generated datasets to ensure appropriate levels of data utility, statistical fidelity, business realism, privacy protection, and business\-rule compliance.
* Troubleshoot generation issues, data quality problems, and validation exceptions.
* Support development of reusable validation frameworks and automation assets.


**Governance, Documentation \& Compliance**
* Support governance processes to ensure Synthetic Data solutions comply with privacy, security, and enterprise standards.
* Assist with disclosure risk assessments, validation reporting, and governance documentation.
* Maintain technical documentation, delivery artefacts, audit trails, and supporting evidence.
* Ensure all activities align with organizational data governance and compliance requirements.


**Service Support \& Continuous Improvement**
* Support day\-to\-day operation of the Synthetic Data Service.
* Assist with user support requests, issue investigations, and delivery activities.
* Contribute to reusable assets, templates, accelerators, and best practices.
* Participate in knowledge\-sharing initiatives and continuous improvement activities.
* Stay current with emerging Synthetic Data technologies, methodologies, and industry trends.


 The role may require periodic allocation of additional time to support critical deliveries, operational activities, or collaboration with global teams operating across multiple time zones.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications, Experience and Skills**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline.
* Relevant Certifications in data Engineering, Analytics, Cloud Technologies, AI, or Synthetic Data Technologies are advantageous.


**Experience**
* Synthetic Data Engineering Expertise (Mandatory) – Minimum 3\+ Years Practical Experience
* Candidates must demonstrate practical experience supporting the implementation, operation, or delivery of Synthetic Data, Test Data Management, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Machine Learning, Data Simulation, or Data Modelling solutions within enterprise environments.


 The successful candidate should have experience in:
   

  

* Python development.
* SQL development.
* Data profiling and analysis.
* Data quality assessment and validation.
* Statistical analysis and distributions.
* Business rule implementation.
* Synthetic Data generation techniques.
* Data modelling and schema analysis.
* Machine Learning fundamentals.


**Data \& Analytics Experience**
* Experience working within Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Data Management, AI, or related technical disciplines.
* Experience working with structured and unstructured datasets.
* Experience supporting data transformation, integration, and automation activities.
* Strong understanding of data quality and data governance principles.


**Technical Skills/Competencies**
**Advanced Level**
* Python
* SQL
* Data Profiling
* Data Quality \& Validation
* Synthetic Data Generation Techniques
* Statistical Analysis
* Data Modelling


**Working Level**
* Machine Learning
* Azure Data Services
* Data Engineering
* APIs \& Automation
* Git \& DevOps
* Data Governance
* Metadata Management


 Candidates must demonstrate practical Synthetic Data engineering experience using Python, SQL, statistical modelling, machine learning, business\-rule implementation, data modelling, and validation techniques. Experience with commercial Synthetic Data platforms is advantageous but not mandatory.
   

  

**Behavioral Competencies**
* Teamwork
* Integrity
* Empathy \& care
* Ownership
* Accountability


**Analytical thinking and problem solving**
* Coherent communication
* Time management and organization
* Extreme attention to detail


**Additional Candidate Validation Requirement:**
**Synthetic Data Experience Validation (Mandatory)**
**Candidates must be able to demonstrate at least two enterprise\-scale Synthetic Data implementations where they personally:**
* Built or maintained Python and SQL generation logic.
* Analyzed source schemas, relationships, dimensions, and business rules.
* Generated or validated Synthetic Data outputs.
* Performed data quality, statistical, and validation activities.
* Supported delivery of Synthetic Data, Test Data, Analytics, or AI solutions into operational use cases.


**Candidates should be prepared to discuss:**
* Synthetic Data generation techniques used.
* Python and SQL development activities performed.
* Validation and quality assessment approaches.

**Experience limited to vendor demonstrations, academic research, training courses, proof\-of\-concepts, or theoretical knowledge will not be considered sufficient.**

description:

 GeoSpatial Senior Analyst MAP will design and enhance enterprise geospatial applications using Java and Net API within a hybrid work environment. The role focuses on advanced spatial data analysis system integration and performance optimization to support strategic business decisions improve operational efficiency and enable socially impactful location based solutions for global clients.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Analyze complex geospatial data sets and transform raw spatial information into actionable insights that support enterprise planning and operational decision making across multiple business domains.
* Design and develop robust geospatial services using Java and Net API that enable reliable map visualization spatial querying and location intelligence features for internal and external applications.
* Implement scalable spatial data processing workflows that optimize performance and accuracy of map related functions while maintaining high standards of data quality and governance.
* Collaborate with product owners and business analysts to translate geospatial requirements into clear technical specifications and solution designs that align with organizational objectives and digital strategies.
* Configure and enhance existing mapping platforms to improve usability response times and functional coverage for users in different regions and business units.
* Conduct detailed code reviews and technical assessments of Java and Net components to ensure adherence to coding best practices security guidelines and long term maintainability standards.
* Coordinate with data engineering teams to define and refine spatial data models that support efficient storage retrieval and analysis of geo referenced information at enterprise scale.
* Develop and maintain automated testing scenarios for geospatial services to ensure reliability of routing distance calculations proximity analysis and other spatial functions under varied data conditions.
* Prepare comprehensive technical documentation for geospatial solutions covering architecture configuration details integration points and operational procedures to support seamless maintenance.
* Engage with cross functional stakeholders to present geospatial findings and explain how spatial patterns influence customer behavior risk exposure and resource allocation decisions.
* Monitor production geospatial systems in the hybrid work model and proactively resolve incidents or performance issues to maintain high service availability during day shift operations.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that leverage advanced spatial analytics to reduce operational costs enhance sustainability efforts and generate measurable benefits for society and clients.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security policies and regulatory expectations when handling location data by applying appropriate access controls anonymization practices and audit mechanisms.


**Qualifications**
* Possess extensive experience in Java based application development with strong skills in building modular code and integrating complex geospatial logic into enterprise platforms.
* Demonstrate deep expertise in Net API development including creation of secure services and interfaces that expose map related functions to diverse consuming applications.
* Apply solid understanding of Net work model concepts to collaborate effectively within hybrid teams and deliver reliable solutions in a structured corporate environment.
* Bring proven background in geospatial analysis tools and spatial databases supporting tasks such as layering buffering and spatial joins for business use cases.
* Utilize strong knowledge of software engineering practices including version control unit testing and continuous integration to maintain high technical quality standards.
* Show proficiency in consuming and producing map based services using industry standard protocols and formats to ensure smooth interoperability between systems.
* Exhibit clear communication skills to explain complex spatial findings to nontechnical stakeholders and to document solution approaches in an accessible manner.
* Apply analytical and problem solving capabilities to diagnose issues in data pipelines mapping services and client applications and to implement effective corrective actions.
* Maintain awareness of emerging trends in geospatial technologies and spatial analytics to suggest enhancements that keep company offerings competitive and socially relevant.

 The Financial Solutions team, part of Fidelity’s Strategic Advisors Inc., is the central team that develops financial solutions and planning methodologies offered to our retail and workplace customers.
   

  

 We help answer questions like “When can I retire?”, “Should I pay down my debt or invest?”, “What’s the real cost of leaving the workforce to care for a loved one?”, “How should I withdraw from accounts of multiple tax\-registration in retirement?” etc. The team also conducts research, provides thought leadership on a range of financial planning topics, and aids in investment product development.
   

  

**The Purpose of the Role**
 As Lead, Financial Solutions, the candidate will be part of the Financial Solutions India Team at Strategic Advisors Inc., driving the development of advanced financial methodologies that underpin Fidelity’s planning and advisory offerings for both retail and workplace clients. The role entails executing the long\-term strategic vision for financial planning frameworks and spearheading the creation of innovative financial solutions. The candidate will collaborate across multiple business units to transform concepts into market\-ready solutions.

 The ideal candidate should be capable of translating real\-world problems into robust mathematical models. title: GTM Research & Operations Specialist
description:
**GTM Research \& Operations Specialist** 





 Build the account\-intelligence and campaign\-operations engine behind Opsolute's enterprise GTM motion.
 




  





**Location** 





 Bengaluru \- hybrid
 




**Employment** 





 Full\-time
 




**Experience** 





 2\-4 years in B2B SaaS research, GTM operations, outbound operations or a closely related role
 




**Works with** 





 Fractional GTM Operator, Founding Enterprise SDR, Founder, Brand \& Content Lead and Design
 




  





**About Opsolute:** 





 Opsolute is building an Infrastructure Cost Intelligence Platform for engineering and finance teams that need to understand not only what their cloud costs, but why. We connect cloud spend to services, applications, products, teams and infrastructure relationships so companies can make faster, safer optimisation decisions and convert identified savings into realised savings.
 





 Our initial focus is on AWS\-heavy businesses across India, followed by UAE/MENA and APAC. We work with organization spending at least USD 50,000 per month on AWS, with priority on complex environments above USD 100,000 per month. Our buyers and champions typically include CTOs, VPs of Engineering, SRE and Platform leaders, FinOps leaders and finance decision\-makers.
 




  





**The role:** 





 You will own the quality and operating discipline behind Opsolute's target\-account motion. Your job is to identify the companies worth pursuing, map the right people, assemble credible account context, maintain clean systems and make every campaign executable and measurable.
 





 This is not a list\-copying or database\-export role. We need someone who can form a point of view about an account: why it fits, what may have changed, who is likely to care, what evidence supports the hypothesis and what the SDR should do next.
 




  





**What you will own:** 




**Account intelligence and prioritization** 



* Build and continuously improve target\-account lists against Opsolute's ICP: AWS\-heavy organizations, generally 50\-5,000 employees, with estimated cloud spend of at least USD 50,000 per month; prepare concise briefs for the highest\-priority accounts.
* Research company structure, technology footprint, cloud maturity, engineering scale, likely spend, relevant initiatives and potential cost or governance pain.
* Track useful buying signals such as funding, engineering or FinOps hiring, cloud migration, new technology leadership, geographic expansion, acquisitions, public cost commentary and infrastructure change.
* Map decision\-makers, champions and influencers across engineering, SRE/platform, FinOps, finance and executive leadership.



**Data, enrichment and systems** 



* Use LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Clay and other approved sources to enrich accounts and contacts with verifiable business and role information.
* Maintain CRM accuracy across company, contact, source, campaign, owner, lifecycle stage, last action, next action and evidence fields.
* Create deduplication, validation and enrichment routines that keep data usable over time.
* Protect deliverability by validating contact data, suppressing risky records and monitoring bounce, unsubscribe and domain\-quality signals.
* Document sources, assumptions and confidence levels instead of presenting uncertain estimates as facts.



**Campaign operations and reporting** 



* Translate approved ICP hypotheses and messaging into campaign\-ready segments, lists, sequences and CRM workflows.



  





**Working relationships:** 



* Partner with the Fractional GTM Operator on ICP design, account tiers, campaign hypotheses, measurement and prioritization.
* Enable the Founding Enterprise SDR with accurate contact data, account briefs, trigger signals and clearly assigned next actions.
* Escalate data, tool, compliance or deliverability risks before they affect campaigns.



  





**Your first 90 days:** 




**First 30 days** 



* Learn Opsolute's product, ICP, personas, existing pipeline and historical campaign performance.
* Audit current account data, enrichment practices, CRM structure, tools, sequences and reporting gaps.
* Rebuild the first priority list of Indian accounts and complete high\-quality briefs for the top tier.



**Days 31\-60** 



* Establish repeatable enrichment, QA, campaign\-launch and CRM\-maintenance routines.
* Publish evidence on which account segments, signals and personas are producing meaningful engagement.



**Days 61\-90** 



* Contribute to the broader GTM campaigns



  





**What we are looking for:** 



* 2\-4 years of relevant experience in B2B SaaS account research, GTM operations, sales operations, outbound operations or demand\-generation operations.
* Hands\-on competence with LinkedIn Sales Navigator and at least one enrichment/workflow platform such as Apollo or Clay.
* Comfort working on a CRM such as HubSpot and maintaining disciplined lifecycle, ownership and next\-action data.



  





**Useful, but not mandatory:** 



* Familiarity with AWS, cloud infrastructure, FinOps, observability or developer\-platform categories.
* Experience with email deliverability, workflow automation, intent data or account\-based outbound.



  





**What this role does not own:** 



* High\-volume cold calling or being the primary voice in prospect conversations; that belongs to the Founding Enterprise SDR.
* Final GTM strategy, pricing, contracting or commercial approval.
* Writing every piece of campaign content or producing design assets.
* Closing revenue independently.



  





**How to apply:** 





 Please share your resume to
 
 gurneet.kaur@opsolute.io
 
 and a short note describing one outbound or account\-research system you personally operated. Tell us the target segment, tools used, how you judged data quality, what reached the market and what changed because of the results. Examples may be anonymized.

title: Master Data Management Business Analyst-1
description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.
   

  

 We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.
   

  

**About Vantive**
 Vantive is a vital organ therapy company dedicated to extending lives and expanding possibilities for patients and care teams around the world. As Vantive continues to establish and optimize its independent operating model, master data serves as a critical business asset that supports operational excellence, regulatory compliance, supply chain effectiveness, financial processes, customer experience, and enterprise decision\-making.
   

  

 Within Global Shared Services / Finance, the Master Data Management (MDM) organization is responsible for delivering high\-quality, governed master data that enables the business to operate effectively across global markets and functions.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The
 **Senior Business Analyst, Master Data Management Operations** 
 is responsible for the day\-to\-day execution and delivery of MDM operational services across multiple master data domains. This role serves as a front\-line operational resource, supporting business users, investigating and resolving data\-related incidents, fulfilling work requests, maintaining data quality, and ensuring service commitments are met.
   

  

 The successful candidate will partner closely with business stakeholders, data stewards, MDM operations teams, IT support teams, and external partners to ensure timely and accurate execution of master data processes. The role requires strong analytical skills, problem\-solving capabilities, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently to identify and resolve issues.
   

  

 This position is ideal for a hands\-on MDM professional who enjoys operational execution, customer support, troubleshooting, process improvement, and managing data within a complex global environment.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
**MDM Operational Service Delivery**
* Execute day\-to\-day master data operations activities across Item, Supplier, Finance, Customer, and other supported master data domains.
* Service work orders, requests, and transactions in accordance with established service level agreements (SLAs), operational procedures, and data governance standards.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents within defined SLAs while ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.
* Analyze and resolve master data issues independently, escalating only when necessary and providing clear documentation of findings and corrective actions.
* Perform root cause analysis on recurring issues and partner with stakeholders to implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
* Monitor work queues, backlog volumes, and service levels to ensure timely completion of requests and adherence to operational targets.


**Data Quality \& Governance**
* Execute data validation, cleansing, enrichment, and maintenance activities to support master data accuracy, consistency, and completeness.
* Ensure compliance with established master data standards, business rules, governance policies, and control requirements.
* Identify data quality issues, exceptions, and process breakdowns and partner with data stewards to drive resolution.
* Support execution of data quality monitoring and remediation activities across assigned master data domains.
* Participate in audits, compliance reviews, and control activities as required.


**Business Support \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Serve as a primary point of contact for business users requiring support related to master data processes, requests, incidents, and inquiries.
* Partner with stakeholders across Finance, Supply Chain, Commercial, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and Shared Services to understand issues and deliver effective solutions.
* Communicate issue status, resolution plans, and service updates in a professional and customer\-focused manner.
* Support business process changes, organizational initiatives, and operational improvements impacting master data management processes.


**Continuous Improvement \& Analytics**
* Identify opportunities to streamline processes, reduce manual effort, improve cycle times, and enhance service delivery performance.
* Support development and maintenance of operational KPIs, dashboards, and performance reporting.
* Utilize data and operational metrics to identify trends, recurring issues, capacity constraints, and improvement opportunities.
* Assist with testing, validation, training, and deployment activities associated with MDM enhancements and projects.
* Maintain and update standard operating procedures, work instructions, process documentation, and knowledge management materials.


**Project Support**
* Participate in MDM projects, system enhancements, process improvement initiatives, and data migration activities.
* Execute assigned project tasks including testing, data validation, business process documentation, issue tracking, and deployment support.
* Collaborate with business and technical teams to ensure successful implementation of solutions that support operational objectives.


**What You'll Bring**
**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Information Systems, Data Management, Engineering, or related field.
* 4\-7 years of experience in Master Data Management, Shared Services, Business Operations, Data Governance, Supply Chain Operations, Finance Operations, or related disciplines.
* Experience working within an operational support environment with defined SLAs and service delivery expectations.
* Proven experience servicing work requests, investigating incidents, troubleshooting issues, and resolving operational problems independently.
* Strong understanding of master data concepts, including data governance, data quality, hierarchy management, workflows, standards, and controls.
* Experience working with MDM and ERP platforms such as Syndigo/Riversand, SAP, SAP MDG, JD Edwards, Oracle, or comparable enterprise systems.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to investigate complex data issues and determine root causes.
* Experience developing and executing testing scenarios, validation activities, and process documentation.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast\-paced operational environment.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting Item Master, Supplier Master, Customer Master, Finance Master Data, or Product Information Management processes.
* Experience using SQL, Power BI, Excel, or similar tools for data analysis and reporting.
* Experience supporting global organizations and working within matrix environments.
* Healthcare, medical device, manufacturing, life sciences, or regulated industry experience.
* Experience working with Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodologies.
* English proficiency required; additional language capabilities are a plus.


**Success in This Role**
**Success In This Role Will Be Measured Through**
* Consistent achievement of SLA commitments and service delivery targets.
* Quality and accuracy of master data transactions and work order execution.
* Timely resolution of incidents and reduction of recurring issues.
* Improvements in data quality, operational efficiency, and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Effective participation in MDM projects and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ability to operate independently while maintaining strong collaboration with business and technology partners.
